opening_line: Saw the Acadia Building Co. site you built, with the completed projects shown next to their original floor plans.
Saw the Dunlavy Speakers site you built, the immersive product sections suit a speaker brand well.
Saw the Silicon Ranch site you built. I've designed a few solar sites myself, so it caught my eye.
Saw the Turnbull School site you built in Ottawa, a warm and inviting feel is hard to get right for a school. I've designed a few school sites myself.
Looks like a lot of your clients are home service trades. I've designed a few plumbing and restoration sites myself.
Saw the RG Pro Builders redesign on your site, a messaging overhaul aimed at bringing in more construction leads. I've designed a few construction sites myself.
Saw the Arc & Oak Millwork case study, the family cabinetry shop in Surrey. I've designed a few construction sites myself.
Saw the Express Plumbing, Heating & Air site you built in Nampa. I've designed a few plumbing and HVAC sites myself.
Saw the Elo Coffee Co. Shopify build, a brand built on third-party tested bags and 10% of profits given away is a good story to design around.
Congrats on the 2026 Webby for the Wildlife Society site, and the People's Voice win for Best User Experience.
